title: Cost vs quality — the model benchmark
blurb: What you pay vs what you get. Opus tops quality at 39.6; a cheap model with pass@k sampling closes much of the gap for a fraction of the cost.
body:
A cost-vs-quality benchmark across models (cost in $, score on a shared eval):

  • Haiku — $184 · 23.0
  • Sonnet — $549 · 23.7
  • Opus — $1,650 · 39.6 (top quality, top cost)
  • "Leanstral" — $18 · 21.9 (cheapest)
  • Leanstral pass@2 — $36 · 26.3
  • Leanstral pass@4 — $72 · 29.3
  • Leanstral pass@8 — $145 · 31.0
  • Leanstral pass@16 — $290 · 31.9

The story: repeated sampling (pass@k) on a cheap model buys most of the quality of a premium model at a fraction of the price — though Opus still holds a clear quality ceiling.
